name: Character modifiers
description: Persistent descriptive variations for generated characters

fields.description: Old scars mark their body and hint at dangers they survived.
Their coloring is unnaturally pale, making familiar features seem strange.
Distinctive natural markings form elaborate patterns across their body.
Exposure to harsh weather has left their features roughened and visibly worn.
One eye is missing or permanently closed, making their face immediately recognizable.
Extensive old burn scars cover a clearly visible part of their body.
Dense tattoos cover much of their visible skin in layered designs.
Deliberate raised scars form repeated ceremonial patterns across their skin.
A clearly visible prosthetic replaces an arm or leg, with materials and workmanship suited to the setting.
Several fingers are missing from one hand, leaving an unmistakable silhouette.
An old injury gives their walk a pronounced and recognizable limp.
Their eyes have an impossible color, shape, or reflection that cannot be mistaken for ordinary variation.
Visible symbols shimmer, shift, or faintly glow across their skin without defining a specific effect.
Veins of an unusual color show clearly beneath the skin in branching patterns.
One outer ear is partly or entirely missing, leaving a distinctive profile.
Long surgical or roughly stitched scars cross several visible areas of their body.
